entries.title: Isaiah 52:1
segments: ¶Awake, awake! Put on your strength, O Zion; Put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city! For the uncircumcised and the unclean Shall no longer come to you.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:2
segments: Shake yourself from the dust, arise; Sit down, O Jerusalem! Loose yourself from the bonds of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion!

entries.title: Isaiah 52:3
segments: For thus says the LORD: "You have sold yourselves for nothing, And you shall be redeemed without money."

entries.title: Isaiah 52:4
segments: For thus says the Lord GOD: "My people went down at first Into Egypt to dwell there; Then the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:5
segments: Now therefore, what have I here," says the LORD, "That My people are taken away for nothing? Those who rule over them Make them wail," says the LORD, "And My name [is] blasphemed continually every day.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:6
segments: Therefore My people shall know My name; Therefore [they shall know] in that day That I [am] He who speaks: 'Behold, [it is] I.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 52:7
segments: ¶How beautiful upon the mountains Are the feet of him who brings good news, Who proclaims peace, Who brings glad tidings of good [things], Who proclaims salvation, Who says to Zion, "Your God reigns!"

entries.title: Isaiah 52:8
segments: Your watchmen shall lift up [their] voices, With their voices they shall sing together; For they shall see eye to eye When the LORD brings back Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:9
segments: Break forth into joy, sing together, You waste places of Jerusalem! For the LORD has comforted His people, He has redeemed Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:10
segments: The LORD has made bare His holy arm In the eyes of all the nations; And all the ends of the earth shall see The salvation of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:11
segments: Depart! Depart! Go out from there, Touch no unclean [thing]; Go out from the midst of her, Be clean, You who bear the vessels of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:12
segments: For you shall not go out with haste, Nor go by flight; For the LORD will go before you, And the God of Israel [will be] your rear guard.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:13
segments: ¶Behold, My Servant shall deal prudently; He shall be exalted and extolled and be very high.

entries.title: Isaiah 52:14
segments: Just as many were astonished at you, So His visage was marred more than any man, And His form more than the sons of men;

entries.title: Isaiah 52:15
segments: So shall He sprinkle many nations. Kings shall shut their mouths at Him; For what had not been told them they shall see, And what they had not heard they shall consider.
